messages:
maya (SRE): paging in — SableHealth reports elevated error rate from their dedicated pool after canary rollout. Seeing 502/504s and slow tail latency.

incident-bot: Incident created (INC-2005). Severity: SEV2. Affected tenant: sable_health-prod (dedicated pool id: dp-08bf).

jordan (Eng): on it. which artifact did the canary use? any pinning?

maya (SRE): canary used artifact rwinfer-1.3.2-optim. We pinned the canary to that artifact for 10% traffic.

samir (Support): SableHealth on the call, they're seeing ~25% of requests time out. They've paused their own retries but want isolation asap.

jordan (Eng): logs show repeated KV cache misses and then OOM-ish spikes on one subset of nodes. Possibly a kernel selection mismatch for quantized kernels.

oncall-sre: I can take the rotation work. maya, can you confirm list of nodes in the dedicated pool? I'll remove the canary nodes from LB.

maya (SRE): pool dp-08bf nodes: dp-08bf-n1..n6. Canary was deployed to n5/n6. Removing n5 first. Command: `rbctl node drain dp-08bf-n5 --grace 30s`

deploy-bot: drain initiated for dp-08bf-n5 by oncall-sre. Active connections draining.

jordan (Eng): while drain completes, we should pin customer back to previous artifact on remaining nodes: rwinfer-1.3.1-stable. Plan: update routing policy for sable_health-prod to route 100% to rwinfer-1.3.1.

oncall-sre: performing routing change now: `rbctl route update --tenant sable_health-prod --artifact rwinfer-1.3.1-stable --weight 100`

maya (SRE): routing update applied. Monitoring for errors.

samir (Support): Told SableHealth we've isolated the canary nodes and pinned them to the previous artifact. They asked for ETA on full rollback.

jordan (Eng): recommend full rollback of canary artifacts from dp-08bf to ensure no residual cache incompatibilities. Steps: 1) pin tenant to rwinfer-1.3.1 (done), 2) redeploy n5/n6 with 1.3.1, 3) validate internal smoke, 4) re-enable full capacity.

oncall-sre: redeploy started on n5/n6: `rbctl deploy dp-08bf-n5 --artifact rwinfer-1.3.1-stable && rbctl deploy dp-08bf-n6 --artifact rwinfer-1.3.1-stable`

deploy-bot: deploy job queued and running for dp-08bf-n5/n6. Jobs: job-7891, job-7892.

maya (SRE): while redeploy happens, isolating tenant-level caches too — evicting prefix cache for sable_health-prod to avoid KV mismatches: `rbctl cache evict --tenant sable_health-prod --prefix "sb_*"`

jordan (Eng): good call. that should prevent stale KV client-state. Also enabling increased logging for 30m for this tenant to catch any regression: `rbctl logging set --tenant sable_health-prod --level debug --duration 30m`

samir (Support): SableHealth asked about customer-visible degradation window. I've given them an initial 20-30 minute window and offered a phone bridge if it extends.

oncall-sre: dp-08bf-n5 redeploy succeeded, n6 still in progress (job-7892 at 60%).

maya (SRE): error rate already dropping to baseline on the metrics I'm watching (5xxs down from 24% -> 3%).

jordan (Eng): n6 finished. Redeploy verified. Running smoke tests: `curl -i -H 'x-tenant: sable_health-prod' https://inference.internal/health` all green.

samir (Support): notifying SableHealth that we've completed rollback to stable artifact and isolated canary. They want a follow-up postmortem and timeline for root cause.

olivia (PM): will own customer comms and PM follow-up. olivia -> samir, please sync on customer-friendly summary.

oncall-sre: handing incident to maya for post-incident cleanup and logs retention. I'll update the oncall log.

maya (SRE): acknowledged. I'll collect kernel-selection traces and quantization mismatch logs, preserve pods and core dumps for 72h, and open a follow-up JIRA to track kernel fallback logic.

jordan (Eng): action items for eng: 1) reproduce on staging with same artifact/quantization flags, 2) add automatic model-variant compatibility check during canary (detect KV schema/quant mismatch), 3) recommend gating canary to 5% until compatibility check.
_meta: Generated synthetic Slack thread about a dedicated/VPC customer canary rollback coordination. Conforms to agents.md: contains root message and replies as a single string; messages prefixed by sender; metadata fields present.
